newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Bridgestone warns first half below yr ago.
newsitem.headline: Bridgestone warns first half below yr ago.

text.p: Tyre maker Bridgestone Australia Ltd said on Thursday that its first half result to June 30, 1997 was likely to be below the result recorded a year ago.

Bridgestone said softer retail conditions than at the same time last year, hot weather in some Australian states and heavy rains in others had affected its operations for the quarter to March 31, 1997. "This will in turn adversely affect the outlook in the company's principal market segments for the first half of the current year, when compared to the A$6.03 million profit after tax recorded for the same period last year," it said.
The company said it retained its strong position in the tyre industry, but said the market was very competitive.
Bridgestone, which is 60 percent owned by Bridgestone Corp of Japan, recorded a 4.2 percent rise in net profit in the year to December 31 to A$15.82 million.
